name: TopCounsel by The L Suite
description: Find the right outside counsel for your specific matter based on insights and rankings from The L Suite -- the leading community of 5000+ inhouse counsel. Our proprietary ranking algorithm is driven by overall aggregated member sentiment, speaking engagements and content of each outside counsel, evidence of expertise provided by outside counsel, outside counsel interviews and other internal datasets. Learn more at topcounsel.ai and lsuite.co.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TopCounsel by The L Suite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TopCounsel by The L Suite to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.techgc.co/api/mcp/topcounsel. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TopCounsel by The L Suite MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TopCounsel by The L Suite provides these MCP tools: find_outside_counsel.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TopCounsel by The L Suite in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

acceptedAnswer.text: TopCounsel by The L Suite requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

acceptedAnswer.text: TopCounsel by The L Suite is developed by The L Suite. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
